name: Elysian Pool cave
region: New Hanover — Roanoke Ridge
landmark: North end of Elysian Pool, west of Van Horn
enter: Leave the horse, walk to the waterfall at the north end of the pool, and pass through the water into the cave. Deeper in, a slope on the right drops to a pit; a small hole in that wall leads toward the Poisonous Trail chamber. Keep a lantern and a manual save.
contents: A polluted cave stream, old camp remains, and cave paintings. The Poisonous Trail treasure (four gold bars) is in the hidden tunnel if you have followed that map chain from Cairn Lake. After all 20 dreamcatchers, the Ancient Arrowhead is in the eye of a bison painting in a side chamber. The pool itself is poisoned by the mine upstream.
accuracyNote: No exact published coordinate. Shown in the list only.

name: Strange Statues cave
region: Ambarino — east of Donner Falls
landmark: A gap in the rocks on the north side of the road east of Donner Falls, near a lone tree
enter: Ride the northern road through the Grizzlies East. On the north side, go up the rocks to a narrow cave mouth. The painting that hints the solution is a separate stop at Window Rock.
contents: Seven statues around a winged figure. Press the statues whose finger counts are the prime numbers 2, 3, 5, and 7. The one-armed statue's missing arm is on the cave floor. The panel in the center statue holds three gold bars. Rear buttons reset a mistake.

name: Mount Shann giant's cave
region: West Elizabeth — near the summit of Mount Shann
landmark: A cave near the top of Mount Shann
enter: Climb Mount Shann. The cave is near the summit, separate from the stone sundial used by the Landmarks of Riches treasure.
contents: The skeleton of a giant. This is a skeleton, not a living Bigfoot. No second creature is confirmed in this cave.

name: Beaver Hollow caves
region: New Hanover — Roanoke Ridge, north of Annesburg
landmark: The cave network just north of the A in Annesburg, east of the Kamassa River
enter: Approach from the roads south of the site. The Murfree Brood use the caves and will shoot on sight before the gang moves here.
contents: A large cave network and a hostile camp. In Chapter 6 it becomes the Van der Linde camp. A Sparrow's Egg Orchid grows in the area. Do not expect a peaceful loot room.

name: Cochinay cave
region: West Elizabeth — Tall Trees
landmark: Cochinay, in Tall Trees
enter: This cave is the setting of the epilogue mission American Venom. This guide does not claim a free-roam treasure route into it before that mission.
contents: The cave camp used for the story's last mission. The reward is the mission itself, not a listed lockbox.

name: Shuttered mine above Elysian Pool
region: New Hanover — north of Elysian Pool
landmark: West side of the river, north of Elysian Pool
enter: Ride north from the pool along the west bank until you reach the boarded mine and the dead yellow ground.
contents: The closed mine that leaks into Elysian Pool. It explains the poisoned water. It is a landmark, not a treasure dungeon, and this guide does not claim an interior full of loot.

name: Gaptooth Breach mine
region: New Austin — Gaptooth Ridge
landmark: The Del Lobo mine at Gaptooth Breach, in the far west
enter: New Austin is locked until the epilogue in a normal playthrough. Ride to Gaptooth Breach and expect a hostile gang camp in the mine.
contents: A mine used as a Del Lobo hideout. Loot is whatever the camp is carrying. It is not a storyless gold vault.

name: Lucky's Cabin basement
region: New Hanover — southwest of Valentine
landmark: The burned cabin southwest of Valentine
enter: Find all three nighttime murder scenes first (10 p.m. to 5 a.m.), then open the basement doors at Lucky's Cabin. Inspect the knife. The full steps are on the Secrets page under American Dreams.
contents: The serial killer's basement, letters, and the fight with Edmund Lowry Jr. About $20 if you stop him when he attacks the Valentine sheriff.

name: Valentine doctor's cellar
region: New Hanover — Valentine
landmark: The doctor's office in Valentine
enter: During Chapter 2, start the back-room robbery at the doctor's office and follow it downstairs.
contents: A hidden cellar and a wounded man the doctor is keeping there. The payoff is the robbery, not a separate treasure map.

name: Rhodes gunsmith cellar
region: Lemoyne — Rhodes
landmark: The gunsmith in Rhodes
enter: Once Rhodes is part of your chapter, rob the gunsmith and open the locked cellar under the shop.
contents: A captive kept in the basement. The scene is the robbery discovery. This guide does not add a separate cash amount.

name: Viking burial
region: New Hanover — rocky shore northeast of Annesburg
landmark: The shore northeast of Annesburg. Many guides place the mound under the R in Roanoke on the world map.
enter: Ride the coast northeast of Annesburg and search the rocks for the burial mound. Climb in and inspect the remains.
contents: A Viking helmet and the Viking Hatchet.

name: Window Rock overhang
region: Ambarino — north of Cumberland Forest
landmark: The overhang at Window Rock
enter: Ride north of Cumberland Forest to Window Rock and walk under the overhang.
contents: A rock painting that hints the Strange Statues puzzle. Inspect it so the drawing is added to the journal. The gold bars are in the statue cave, not here.
accuracyNote: Approximate. This is the published strange-statues painting, which the guide associates with Window Rock, not a separate overhang survey.

name: Granite Pass train ravine
region: Ambarino — southwest of Cotorra Springs
landmark: The ravine at Granite Pass
enter: Find the wrecked train in the ravine and climb through the tilted cars to the upright car lodged below the cliff. Save before the climb. A fall can kill you.
contents: Two gold bars in the upright car. Story Mode only.
accuracyNote: Approximate. GTA Boss publishes the derailed train at 73.45, 31.5 in its web-mercator tile frame. Converted into this frame from 14 shared landmarks (RMS 0.7118 map units).

name: Fort Wallace cliff ledge
region: New Hanover — cliffs northeast of Fort Wallace
landmark: The narrow ledges northeast of Fort Wallace
enter: This is the last climb of the High Stakes treasure, after the Cumberland Falls and Barrow Lagoon maps. Follow the low overhang. Save first.
contents: Three gold bars at the end of that treasure chain. The route is the hidden part; there is no separate cave door.
accuracyNote: Approximate. This is the published Fort Wallace coordinate. The cliff ledge is not a separate point in the source file.

name: Caliban's Seat
region: Ambarino — north of O'Creagh's Run
landmark: The rock spire called Caliban's Seat
enter: Climb the spire as part of the Jack Hall Gang treasure, after the first map from Maximo near Flatneck Station.
contents: The next Jack Hall treasure map, stashed in the rocks. The gold bars are later, on the island in O'Creagh's Run.
accuracyNote: No exact published coordinate. Shown in the list only.

name: The Loft
region: New Hanover — cliff north of Annesburg
landmark: The cliff house called The Loft, north of Annesburg
enter: Climb the trails north of Annesburg to the house on the cliff. It is easy to miss from the road.
contents: A sniper's nest. The unique gun here is a Rolling Block Rifle.

name: Meteor House
region: New Hanover — Roanoke Ridge, west of Brandywine Drop
landmark: The ruined house south of the Abandoned Trading Post, along the railroad west of Brandywine Drop
enter: Follow the tracks west of Brandywine Drop and go into the smashed house.
contents: A meteorite in the smoking hole in the floor, and the remains of the people who lived there. Paired with the crater to the northwest. A third meteorite is not confirmed.

name: Meteor crater
region: New Hanover — northwest of Meteor House
landmark: The barren crater northwest of Meteor House, across the tracks
enter: From Meteor House, cross the railroad tracks toward the northwest and look for the cleared crater in the trees.
contents: The second meteorite, in the center of the crater. The satchel can read 2 of 3. Nobody has confirmed a third piece.

name: Whinyard Strait
region: Ambarino — western Grizzlies, near Lake Isabella
landmark: The snowy cut called Whinyard Strait
enter: Ride the high western Grizzlies near Lake Isabella and take the narrow frozen cut instead of the main road.
contents: A hard mountain passage. No unique loot is confirmed for this entry; it is here because the cut is easy to miss.
accuracyNote: No exact published coordinate. Shown in the list only.

name: Spider Gorge
region: Ambarino — a narrow canyon in the Grizzlies
landmark: Spider Gorge
enter: Find the named canyon in Ambarino and walk the tight passage. It is not a cave door.
contents: The canyon itself. No unique reward is confirmed in this guide, so none is listed.
accuracyNote: No exact published coordinate. Shown in the list only.
